# AITBASE VISION Plugin SDK

> Build plugins with their own screens for AITBASE VISION camera robots. Plugins are C callbacks plus restricted LVGL-style XML screens; the device renders the UI and owns the two physical buttons. Preview (SDK 0.5, plugin API 1): capabilities ui, storage, http and audio.output; the device runs plugins from its SD card (Developer mode, on by default).

Start a project with `aitbase-plugin init <dir> --id <yourname.plugin>` and follow its AGENTS.md. Do not use features that are not listed in these documents.

## Docs

- [Project instructions for agents](https://github.com/Aitbase/aitbase-vision-plugin-sdk/blob/main/template/AGENTS.md): rules, supported features, input model, the check/build/pack loop
- [CLI reference](https://github.com/Aitbase/aitbase-vision-plugin-sdk/blob/main/docs/cli.md): commands, JSON output, every diagnostic code
- [UI XML](https://github.com/Aitbase/aitbase-vision-plugin-sdk/blob/main/docs/ui-xml.md): accepted widgets, attributes, colors, actions and limits
- [C API](https://github.com/Aitbase/aitbase-vision-plugin-sdk/blob/main/include/aitbase_plugin.h): callbacks, calls and events
- [Capabilities](https://github.com/Aitbase/aitbase-vision-plugin-sdk/blob/main/docs/capabilities.md): storage, HTTP and sound; limits, status and error codes (generated from the device)
- [Package format](https://github.com/Aitbase/aitbase-vision-plugin-sdk/blob/main/docs/package-format.md): .avp files and SD card layout (draft)

## Optional

- [Plugin protocol](https://github.com/Aitbase/aitbase-vision-plugin-sdk/blob/main/docs/plugin-protocol.md): device wire protocol; plugins never use it directly
- [WASM host ABI](https://github.com/Aitbase/aitbase-vision-plugin-sdk/blob/main/docs/wasm-abi.md): how a plugin compiled to WebAssembly talks to the device (preview); plugins never use it directly
- [UI schema](https://github.com/Aitbase/aitbase-vision-plugin-sdk/blob/main/schema/plugin_ui_registry.json)
- [Manifest schema](https://github.com/Aitbase/aitbase-vision-plugin-sdk/blob/main/schema/plugin.schema.json)
- [Example plugins](https://github.com/Aitbase/aitbase-vision-plugins)
